title: Build rerank evaluation pipeline for customer prompt sets and A/B splits
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a scalable reranking evaluation pipeline that computes NDCG@k and MRR for customer-provided prompt sets, supports deterministic A/B splits for online experiments, and exposes time-series metrics to Console for regression alerts. This ticket covers the ingestion format for prompt sets, offline and online eval flows, experiment tagging, and low-latency instrumentation hooks in the rerank endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Pipeline ingests customer prompt sets (JSONL with query, ground_truth_ids, and metadata) and produces daily NDCG@1/3/5 and MRR reports per prompt set and per model-variant. 2) Rerank endpoint emits experiment_variant and promptset_id in request logs and tracing metadata without adding >1ms median latency. 3) Console shows a per-promptset time series and a regression alert when NDCG@3 drops >5% week-over-week. 4) A/B split mechanism creates deterministic buckets from request_id and respects customer opt-out flags. 5) Unit & integration tests cover score calculations and telemetry emission.
implementation_notes: Architecture: (a) Ingest layer validates promptsets and writes canonical rows to warehouse table rerank_promptsets_staging (dedupe on promptset_hash), (b) Offline evaluator job (Airflow) materializes embeddings via embedding service, computes rerank scores for each model variant using same ranking code path as runtime, calculates NDCG@k and MRR, writes timeseries to metrics_store and summary to rerank_evals_daily, (c) Online instrumentation: rerank service attaches 'promptset_id' and 'experiment_variant' fields to trace/span and to structured access logs; telemetry processor (kafka->ingest) aggregates per-minute counters and forwards to Console metrics pipeline. Scaling: use sharded job workers keyed by promptset_hash, batch embedding calls to reduce token cost, and cap candidate list size at 200 for offline runs to bound compute. Privacy: strip any PII from promptsets before persisting; provide opt-out flag in ingestion API.
tradeoffs_and_decisions: - Use truncated NDCG@k (k=3,5) instead of full-list NDCG to match product relevance needs and reduce compute costs. - Offline evaluator approximates full rerank by sampling if candidate set >200; we accept small variance vs exact calculation to keep daily run under 2 hours. - Deterministic bucketing uses FNV-1a on request_id for reproducible A/B splits; alternative (hash-to-int mod N) tested but produced uneven buckets for our request_id distribution. - Instrumentation uses structured logs + kafka aggregation instead of synchronous DB writes to avoid latency spikes.
metrics_definition: ndcg@1, ndcg@3, ndcg@5 computed with DCG gain=2^rel-1 and log2 discount; MRR is mean reciprocal rank over queries where ground truth appears. Also track per-model latency P50/P95 for rerank-only stage, embedding call latency, and per-promptset sample count. Alert conditions: ndcg@3 drop >5% or mrr drop >7% vs 7-day rolling baseline with min 100 queries.
tasks: Define promptset JSONL schema and validation rules
Implement ingestion API and staging table
Add promptset_id and experiment_variant to rerank service traces
Build offline Airflow DAG to compute ndcg/mrr daily
Publish metrics to Console and add alerting rule
Add end-to-end tests and performance microbenchmarks
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: customer promptsets include PII or large documents causing costs. Mitigation: enforce max prompt length, automatic PII scrub, and explicit opt-in checkbox. Risk: offline eval diverges from runtime due to caching/batching differences. Mitigation: reuse production ranking code path and mirror KV-cache warmup in a smoke-run. Risk: A/B bucketing imbalance. Mitigation: monitor bucket distributions weekly and provide re-seeding option.
